notes.title: NEDRA – Update v1.0.5
notes.notes:
This update focuses on improving gameplay balance, fixing bugs, and addressing community feedback. As a solo developer, I truly appreciate all the support and detailed reports you've shared.

What's new in v1.0.5:

Minor bug fixes and stability improvements

Adjusted combat for better balance

Increased time before hypothermia begins

Fixed several audio issues

Fixed collision issues in various areas

Reduced intensity of the alcohol screen effect

Enlarged the warning text in the main menu about potentially uncomfortable visual/audio elements

Other small fixes and improvements

Thanks again to everyone who’s played and provided feedback. I’ll continue working to improve the game with future updates.

notes.title: Dev Update #2: Do you have a minute?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320266/2aa06603e4f263f986aed6f60a2017571a364734.png[/img]

[h2][b]It's been an exciting journey developing NEDRA and now that I'm approaching a key milestone, I want to open up the conversation with all of you—the players who love survival horror as much as I do.[/b][/h2]

By now, you know that NEDRA takes place in the frozen isolation of a Soviet Antarctic station. It's a game of survival, where managing body temperature is as crucial as avoiding the horrors lurking in the cold. You'll need to make strategic choices—whether to engage threats head-on or slip past unnoticed. Every decision matters, and every resource is scarce.

As I get closer to releasing more updates and preparing for NEDRA's Next Fest debut, I’d love to hear your thoughts:

[list]
[*] What about NEDRA excites you the most?

[*] What gameplay elements are you most looking forward to?
 
[*] What aspects of survival horror games do you love (or dislike) the most?
[/list]

I’m also curious about how you like to engage with games and their development:

[list]
[*] Do you enjoy behind-the-scenes content from game development?
 
[*] What do you want to learn about NEDRA’s creation process?
 
[*] What’s your favorite platform to connect with fellow horror fans?
[/list]

While I can’t promise every piece of feedback will make it into the game, knowing what excites and intrigues you helps shape the experience.

With your support, I'll make NEDRA the best it can be.

Davit

notes.title: Forging New Frontiers: indie.io Joins the Journey to Bring NEDRA to More Gamers
notes.notes:
We’re beyond excited to officially announce that NEDRA is partnering with indie.io! After years of developing this game solo, this collaboration is a monumental step forward and I’m thrilled to have their incredible support as we bring NEDRA to even more players around the world.

[h3]About NEDRA[/h3]
For those discovering the game for the first time, NEDRA is a survival horror experience set in the eerie depths of a Soviet Antarctic station. Combining action, adventure, and an innovative body-temperature mechanic reminiscent of stealth gameplay, the game has been my passion project for years.

I began crafting NEDRA with a deep love for atmospheric storytelling, weaving a Lovecraftian atmosphere into the unusual setting of a Soviet station, blending it with just a touch of Carpenter's The Thing to heighten the tension. Inspired by the philosophical undertones of Stanisław Lem, the game also explores themes of human resilience and the unknown forces that push us to the brink. 

What keeps me going? The dream of sharing this world with gamers everywhere and hearing how NEDRA resonates with them. This partnership with indie.io is a huge step in making that dream a reality.

[h3]Why We’re Partnering with indie.io.[/h3]
Partnering with indie.io allows us to bring NEDRA to more players worldwide. Their expertise in supporting indie developers, managing marketing, and showcasing games at live events makes them the perfect fit. With their help, I can focus on making NEDRA the best it can be. Other developers have praised their dedication, and I’m excited to have them on board to help NEDRA reach its deserving audience.

Check Out indie.io
Explore more incredible indie games on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio] indie.io’s Steam Publisher Page [/url]!

[h3]Stay Connected[/h3]
The journey doesn’t stop here. Make sure to:
Wishlist and follow NEDRA on Steam to stay up to date with all our news and announcements.
Join our Discord to connect with the community, share your thoughts, and be part of the adventure.
[url=https://discord.gg/SD7z4SpuxA]DISCORD[/url]
Follow us on social media for more updates, sneak peeks, and behind-the-scenes content.
[url=https://x.com/NEDRAGAME]NEDRA On X[/url]

Your support means everything to me and I can’t wait to share more about NEDRA as we move forward with this exciting partnership!

Thank you for being part of this journey, and let’s keep the adventure going!
